prompt.project_info: Create a realistic cozy bedroom portrait of an original approved adult woman styling a black faux-fur winter hat.
prompt.main_subject: An original approved adult woman with pale skin, subtle freckles, light blue eyes, long dark brown softly waved hair, and natural makeup wears a cream ribbed tank top, dark blue-and-white plaid pleated skirt, and a large black faux-fur ushanka-style hat. Both hands gently touch the hat, and multiple delicate chain bracelets decorate her wrists.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered vertical close portrait, direct calm gaze, hands framing the hat, soft white bedding, ivy-covered white wall feature, gentle background blur, visible ribbed knit, fur, plaid, and jewelry texture.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm diffused indoor light with gentle catchlights and soft shadows, cozy trendy winter atmosphere, natural highlights on shoulders and hat without body-part emphasis.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic 35mm portrait photography, f/2.8, ISO 200, vertical 4:5, sharp facial features and accessories, soft background bokeh, natural skin pores, restrained color, no artificial HDR look.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic vertical 4:5 cozy bedroom portrait of an original approved adult woman with pale skin, subtle freckles, light blue eyes, long dark brown softly waved hair, and natural makeup wearing a cream ribbed tank top, dark blue-and-white plaid pleated skirt, and a large black faux-fur ushanka-style hat. Both hands gently touch the hat and delicate chain bracelets decorate her wrists. Soft white bedding and an ivy-covered white wall feature sit behind her. Warm diffused indoor light, gentle catchlights, natural skin pores, realistic fur and fabric texture, soft winter coquette atmosphere, 35mm lens at f/2.8.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, childlike features, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, body-part emphasis, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, over-saturated, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed anatomy, unreadable jewelry text
